equivalence: For odd q, dim Bike(Levi)=q^3+q-1 iff rank_F2(N)=1+q(q+1)^2/2=rank_Q(N).
rational_rank_proof: NN^T=(q+1)I+A and the W(3,q) collinearity spectrum is q(q+1)^1,(q-1)^[q(q+1)^2/2],-(q+1)^[q(q^2+1)/2]. Hence rank_Q N=1+q(q+1)^2/2.
binary_bicycle_proof: For odd q, q+1 is even and BB^T mod2=[[0,N],[N^T,0]] for the Levi vertex-edge incidence B. Thus ker(BB^T) has dimension 2 null(N); connectedness removes the one-dimensional all-ones kernel under B^T, giving dim Bike=2 null(N)-1.
boundary: No binary rank drop is exact at q=3,5,7,9,11,13. A proof for every odd prime power is still missing, so the all-odd-q bicycle formula remains conjectural.
